verdict.rationale: AI Gateway supports rate limiting (fixed/sliding, request-count based) and via Dynamic Routing explicitly documents 'Restricting each user/project/team with budget/rate limits' and quota enforcement in routing flows, which maps to giving an agent its own guardrailed access. However, there's no explicit documentation of issuing a distinct API key per autonomous agent or a dollar-denominated spend cap/kill-switch — the budget/rate controls are described at user/project/team granularity via routing config rather than as agent-specific key issuance with hard spend limits. Missing for 10: explicit per-agent API key issuance, concrete spend-based (not just request-count) budget caps, and independent/hands-on confirmation these guardrails actually prevent runaway spend in practice.
